name: powerplatform-open-source-hub-pipeline
description: TypeScript candidate pipeline for generating Power Platform open-source repository data.

scripts.dry-run: npm run build --silent && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('Output/GeneratedRepositories',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('Output/CuratedRepositories',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('Output/CuratedRepositories',{recursive:true});" && node dist/cli.js generate --dry-run --output Output/GitHubRepositoriesGenerated.json --generated-dir Output/GeneratedRepositories --metrics Output/metrics.json && node dist/cli.js merge --generated-dir Output/GeneratedRepositories --overlay-dir Output/CuratedRepositories --output Output/GitHubRepositoriesDetails.json --schema ../Configuration/Schemas/GitHubRepositoriesDetails.schema.json --taxonomy-dir ../Configuration/Taxonomy --sentinels ../Configuration/SentinelRepositories.json
scripts.compare:fixtures: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js compare --baseline .\tests\fixtures\comparison\baseline.json --candidate .\tests\fixtures\comparison\candidate.json --sentinels .\tests\fixtures\comparison\sentinels.json --report .\.test-output\parity-fixture-report.json
scripts.generate:live: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js generate --live --output .\Output\GitHubRepositoriesDetails.json --metrics .\Output\metrics.json
